question: A thin, non-conducting rod of length $L$ is placed along the x-axis, from $x=0$ to $x=L$. The rod has a non-uniform linear charge density given by $λ(x) = αx$, where $α$ is a positive constant. What is the magnitude of the electric field at a point P located on the x-axis at $x = -L$?
